SELECT fish_date_season AS season, CAST(fish_date_doy/20 AS INT)*20 AS doy_bucket, cls,
  SUM(yt) AS yt, SUM(anglers) AS anglers, COUNT(*) AS n,
  ROUND(SUM(yt)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0),3) AS ypa
FROM trips
WHERE cls IN ('hd_am','hd_pm','hd_unspecified','hd_twilight','three_quarter','full_day','overnight','day_1_5')
GROUP BY 1,2,3
HAVING SUM(anglers) > 50
ORDER BY season, doy_bucket, ypa DESC
